page.overview:
Who is Blemmy?

was the dwarven leader of the crew that had won the Hour of Honor three weeks in a row before Mighty Nein's victory. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Ol’ Blemmy was a dwarf with a giant gash down his face, and a snow-blind eye in the eye socket under the gash. His gray-black, salt-and-pepper beard is so unkempt that it is difficult to see his mouth.

Originally, he was an ice sailor on the Frigid Depths out of Icehaven, but he retired ten years before the Mighty Nein encountered him in Hupperdook.
